example.title: Pier-end restaurant building, Oceanside Pier (1990s; burned 2024)

brief: A 1990s restaurant at the end of the wooden pier: a two-storey timber building with a blue-grey hipped roof and cupola, a glazed upper dining room, white trim and a railed deck, standing on the widened pier end among the lamp posts. Two photos (it burned in 2024). Piles 10 m below the bed (spec rule 4).
label: Playa Verde Pier
